name: Qwen Image Edit 2511 人物朝向编辑提示词
description: 为 Replica 人物资产的 canonical front 主身份图编译 Qwen Image Edit 2511 朝向编辑约束，只允许把同一人物转换为侧面或背面，并强制保持身份、体型、服装与鞋履一致。
when_to_use: 人物资产已由 Z-Image Turbo 生成唯一正面主身份图，需要基于该图生成同一人物的严格侧面或背面全身图
when_not_to_use: 没有 canonical front 主身份图
需要改变人物服装、年龄、发型或体型

steps.title: 编译同身份朝向编辑约束
steps.description: Treat Image 1 as the authoritative character identity and wardrobe source, then compile a side-profile or rear-view edit instruction that changes orientation only.

provider_rules: Image 1 is the authoritative canonical identity and wardrobe reference; do not redesign or reinterpret the person.
Only camera/person orientation may change. Preserve the same facial structure, apparent age, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone and body proportions.
Preserve garment topology exactly: same upper garment, sleeve length, lower-garment type and length, colors, patterns, fabric appearance and footwear presence/type/color.
Never substitute trousers, shorts, skirts or dresses for one another; never remove footwear or change footwear type.
Side output must be a strict 90-degree left-facing full-body profile; rear output must show the exact back of head and body with no visible face.
Keep exactly one person, neutral standing pose, head and both feet fully visible, clean light studio background, no added props, text or extra people.
Do not invent character facts from the storyboard or dialogue; the canonical front image is the visual identity truth for these derived orientations.
completion_criteria: Qwen edit instruction treats the canonical front as authoritative identity
Wardrobe and footwear are explicitly locked
No new semantic character identity is invented
failure_policy: Missing canonical front image blocks side/back generation
Missing Qwen Image Edit model or required ComfyUI nodes fails closed
Runtime must not fall back to independent text-to-image side/back sampling
